input.subject: Confirmed - private showing 20 Pine St #2011 Fri 8/15 3:30pm
input.bodyText:
Hi Amanda,

You're all set for Friday, August 15th at 3:30 PM.

20 Pine St, Unit 2011, Financial District

Text me at (212) 555-0119 when you're 10 min out. Looking forward to it.

Greg Lang
Douglas Elliman
